definitions.switch_us: FPGA requested-model change to end of first complete visible target frame; UART transport excluded
definitions.task_ms: Firmware CLINT timer: task start/admission to completion, including scheduling and IRQ wait; serial transport and result printing excluded; 1ms granularity
definitions.frame_continuity: Counters and video are evidence of corruption/blanking/underflow; skipped/stale increments require comparison with the baseline, not an automatic zero-drop verdict
